title: Manzar Lahu Bhara Hai Maidane Karbala Hai
body:
Manzar lahu bhara hai maidan-e-Karbala hai
Kab hogi aaise shadi dulha dulhan hai pyase
Dulha jahan hai pyasa, dulhan waha pyasi
Is shaan ka jahan mein kya aaqd bhi hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Beta kahan ho aao, Qasim ka haal dekho
Maidan-e-Karbala mein zehra ki yeh sada hai
Qasim hamara beta, ghodey se girraha hai
Nousha Hassan ka dilbar pamaal horaha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai shour asmaan par ,wo khush hua hai lashkar
Farwa neh sabse pucha ab kon aaraha hai
Fizza pukari Zainab, kubra ko ab sambhalo
Masnadh bichao dulha maqtal se aaraha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shre ki lardiya bhikri, nousha hey Karbala ki
Qasim Hassan ka dilbar pamaal horaha hai
Farwa ke dil ko thamo, kubro ko bhi sambhalo
Paamal hoke Qasim maqtal se aaraha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam ki hai sadaae, roone ki hai sadaae
Iqbal Abedi ka nouha rula raha hai
